subject: general
question: Apart from which one of the following, the President of India can make rules for peace, progress and good government of all Union Territories?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chandigarh.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Article 240** deals with the **power of the President** to make regulations for certain **Union territories.**
